oneOf.description: A command in the person's terminal (`devtab add`, `devtab add --write`).
The companion's confirmation window, after the page asked.

A trusted folder (`devtab trust`) the project lies in or was added through; `location` names the folder
(null when it is no longer trusted).

The person made it read-only (`devtab read-only`, `project.setView`); a trusted folder does not make it
writable again.

summary: Asks to add a folder (an absolute path). Inside a trusted folder: added at once. Elsewhere: only after the person confirms in the companion's window; every refusal of the folder is `not-found`.
